The requirement's one MUST for a site is that each link to a file of specialized material says when to read that file. The file has no Markdown links, so it has no link that could fail this. It does name two files in backticks, and both come with a trigger:
- Workflow step 3 (review) tells the agent to have each subagent read this skill's `references/review-prompt.md`, along with the habeas skill's `SKILL.md`. The trigger is the step 3 review of new or changed requirements.
- The "Choosing references" section points to the habeas-evidence skill's `references/fixme.md` for when to defer a requirement gap the user agrees to with `{fixme}`.

The requirement's other obligation, "MAY put material in linked files", is optional. There are no violation matches to judge, and I found no gap.
